description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments : Yakkala North, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, extent measurements, ownership details, and amendments to title particulars. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
